title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26
lineage: PCM > Sony PCM601esd (spdif out) > VX Pocket/Laptop > Nuendo > Waves q10 > WAV 16/44

ai_review.summary: Betty Cantor‑Jackson soundboard capture of a prime 1973 hometown marathon with smoking Help → China → Rider, Half Step and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent Betty Board tape that delivers clear, balanced sound (with only a few minor audience drop‑outs) and even showcases Garcia’s debut ‘Cobra’ guitar. Musically the show is in top form – three relentless sets packed with extended jams, standout performances of Help on the Way > China > Rider, Half Step, Truckin’, Sugar Magnolia and more. Reviewers rave about the band’s energy, tight harmonies and memorable moments despite a tiny vocal slip on Box of Rain.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give five stars and praise both the performance (energy, jams, standout songs) and the Betty‑board recording quality; only minor technical hiccups are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced Betty Cantor‑Jackson tape with crisp guitar detail (including the new Cobra). A few minor audience drop‑outs are mentioned but do not detract from overall clarity.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > China > Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon that builds from a warm‑up first set to near‑perfect second and third sets, with seamless transitions and extended jams keeping the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar shines – debuting his ‘Cobra’ instrument and delivering rich, smoking tones throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil provides strong harmonies and powerful bass lines, highlighted on Truckin' and the space‑laden Too segment.
